description: This file defines a benchmarking class 'FanoutBenchmark' for testing grain communication patterns in an Orleans-based distributed system. It sets up multiple silos and a client, manages their lifecycle, and provides benchmark methods for pinging grains.

classes.name: FanoutBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class for testing fanout grain communication patterns across multiple Orleans silos.

methods.name: FanoutBenchmark
methods.description: Constructor that initializes silos and client based on parameters.

methods.name: CancelPressed
methods.description: Handles console cancel event to exit the application.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Benchmark method that pings the grain.

methods.name: PingForever
methods.description: Continuously pings the grain in an asynchronous loop.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all hosts and client connections.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unsubscribes from events.
